problem_type: Mode-specific defaults project billing kind instead of published execution capability
symptom: Settings and resident model pickers offer t2i-only models for image editing and imported I2V-only models for text-to-video.
direct_cause: The shared default option builder filters by billing kind only; encode/decode ignore which task picker is using the identity.
class_root: The default selection projection bypasses the existing rowServesMode owner.
affected_population: Both settings and resident Agent model selectors
Renamed imported workflows and same-named models from different vendors
internal_only_reason: Internal projection defect; the existing shared modelPublication.rowServesMode contract already defines the answer.
invariants: Only a usable row publishing the requested task mode can be offered or encoded/decoded for that default.
Exact vendor/model identity and explicit automatic selection are preserved.
No stored setting is silently rewritten or another model substituted.

door_reduction.why_not: Distinct existing UI/result consumers remain; the owner projection and its private helper are included by generated door scans.

generality_proof: All four task pickers and both UI surfaces consume the same mode-scoped options and identity resolver; existing publication/availability evidence remains authoritative.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Project canonical rowServesMode evidence into task-scoped choices and exact identity resolution.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Generated door map confirms this selector consumes buildDefaultModelOptions; mode-scoped encode/decode must be passed the same task.
Generated door map confirms this selector consumes buildDefaultModelOptions; mode-scoped encode/decode must be passed the same task.

recurrence.reason: Any provider or imported graph can expose only one mode of a billing kind; both existing consumers share the faulty projection.
same_class_scan: Compared catalog.mode-serving rowServesMode and generationDefaultModelResolver task publication checks

prevention.invariant: All choices and their identity conversions require canonical support for the requested mode.
prevention.failure_mode: Unsupported saved or foreign-task identities return null and are not offered; no fallback.
prevention.strategy: Replace billing-kind-only filtering with rowServesMode and require task context for encode/decode.

legacy_paths.rationale: The old kind-only projection and task-blind identity conversions are replaced in the same change.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency upgrade; reuse existing shared publication contract.

migration: Existing stored choices are preserved. Unsupported preferences project unavailable instead of being silently changed.
residual_risks: No paid inference is authorized. Visual acceptance and final build activation remain separate tasks.
